title.label: Best free calendar application in all of the internet

content.label: Before using this, i used a physical diary. A physical diary is impractical as to carry it everywhere along with a pen plus it’s limited space and also my life became more demanding which prompted me to find an alternative. I tried a couple of calendar apps but I’ll spare you the details. Essentially, this app was the best. Other apps asked for a paid subscription and if you didn’t, you wouldn’t access to basic features such as being able set alerts once an event begins(ironic because this feature is also limited in this program but ill get to it). The ability to EASILY drag tasks/events to certain times or days, was a feature that really is intuitive and I think would make a difference in the 90% of people reading this review. Not only that but what they call “inbox” in this program also doubles down as a to-do list which is incredibly handy. Having one app that takes all these needs is super beneficial. However I would give this program a 4.8/5 if they was an option. And that is the ability to being able to set alerts prior to an event/task AND able to repeat events. Of course if you pay for their paid subscription, you’ll get these features. However, I believe that these two are fundamental features to a calander app and I know for a lot of people, it can be a deal breaker, if they dont have one or both of these features. Other than that though, no complaints whatsover. Excellent Excellent program that really has been programmed with care and precision making sure every part of the user experience is smooth and intuitive. At least on my MacBook Air. I would expect the same on all other devices. It runs well on my iPhone too. Thank you developers for creating such an extraordinary program

title.label: Great for my silly lil Neurospicy brain

content.label:
I massively struggle with time management and task hopping due to my ADHD, even with medication, and am constantly making & losing track of to-do lists. Structured helps me prioritise tasks, colour code the things I need to for uni/work/personal life/medical needs etc, gives me much needed timely reminders AND I get a fun little dopamine reward boost every time I check something off. My fave feature is the inbox; whenever I think of something I need to do I can just jot it down in the moment without having to commit to when to do it, and then when I have the mental capacity to organise myself I can easily transfer it into the calendar. I also love the cute suggestions for small time gaps - yah I absolutely do want a stretch/snack, thank you, I forgot to eat and take care of myself again oops 🫠

The only gripe I have is that when I delete an event in my Apple calendar that has already transferred to structured, it doesn’t also update the event in the structured app, so I end up having to edit two calendars. But that might be due to my rather embarrassing inability to work technology so take it as you will. Yeah I forget to use it for days at a time, but I still love it. 10/10 would recommend.

I love the fact that you can connect the One Sec app and it caters for people who are dyslexic. This is seriously an app that cares for people! But I can see a snowballing effect and some overwhelm happening using the inbox function.
